entry.title: 2. A 3D scan of Nicolas Cage’s skull was used in the 2007 film Ghost Rider.
entry.content: For his starring roll in 2007’s Ghost Rider a full 3D scan of Nicolas Cage’s body was taken by the special effects team. They used the scan to help create Cage’s immolated super-hero form, including the shape of the flame-covered skull.

entry.title: 1. The Batman effect describes a spontaneous event that triggers prosocial behavior.
entry.content: In a study published in Nature, researchers found in their experiment that riders on public transit were more willing to give their seat to a pregnant woman when in the presence of a man dressed as Batman.
